paragraphs.text:
You recognize the man’s style of dress to be that of a Buddhist 
monk. You bow a customary greeting, to which the monk smiles 
and returns the gesture before speaking in heavily accented but 
fluent English. “It is good to see one here with such respect for our 
customs. I am Banyu.” His expression turns to a frown as he makes 
a sweeping gesture to the rest of the room. “The rest here seem only 
to seek to profit from my culture. Selling the items of my ancestors 
is most shameful.” You respectfully question why he would come 
such a long way to witness such a thing, and he sighs before 
turning back to you. “I have come with what money my temple could 
gather so that I might save a certain few of the artifacts. Ones that 
your Professor Harris stole from my temple in Sarnath when he came 
to visit some years ago.” The monk seems troubled and falls silent. 
He bows a farewell and you take the cue to leave.
